name: Richter Escanor
acNote: Assumed plate 18 + Fighting Style: Defense 1 (the sheet lists no armor)
saveNotes: Born to the Saddle: advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount.

actions.name: Richterstorm
actions.text: Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + Str Slashing; versatile 1d10. Extra Attack: two attacks with the Attack action. When you hit, the target is marked by Unwavering Mark (use the Mark button).

actions.name: Unwavering Mark
actions.text: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, mark it until the end of your next turn. While it's within 5 ft of you it has disadvantage on attacks that don't target you. If it damages anyone else, you can make a Mark Strike as a bonus action on your next turn.

actions.name: Mark Strike
actions.text: Special melee attack against a creature you marked that damaged someone else: advantage, and +4 damage on a hit.

actions.name: Warding Maneuver
actions.text: When you or a creature within 5 ft is hit by an attack while you hold a melee weapon or shield, roll 1d8 and add it to the target's AC. If the attack still hits, the target has resistance to its damage.

rollOnly.label: add it to the AC against that attack

actions.name: Action Surge
actions.text: Take one additional action this turn.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.text: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; land on your feet from falls of 10 ft or less; mounting costs 5 ft.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.text: See Actions (5 Mark Strikes per long rest).

features.name: Rustic Hospitality
features.text: Common folk will hide and shelter you, short of risking their lives.

token: Richter Escanor, a short, powerfully built young human cavalier: square jaw, determined eyes, plate armour scarred from many fights, a stormy-blue cloak, holding Richterstorm, a longsword with a crackling storm-blue crystal in its pommel and faint lightning running along the blade. Steady, loyal and immovable.
flags: Gear: Richter's sheet lists no armor and no weapons (it shows AC 10 unarmored, yet he has the Defense fighting style). I gave him plate (AC 19) and Richterstorm as a longsword (+8 to hit, 1d8 + 5 Slashing). Send his real armor, shield and sword.
Name: the sheet says “Richter Cavalier”; your campaign notes call him Richter Escanor, so I used that.
